_readme: The one source of colour and type for both stacks. Edit THIS file, then run `node design/build-tokens.mjs`. It writes design/tokens.css (web) and design/Theme.kt (Android). Never edit those two by hand — they are overwritten.

color._comment: Ground. Dark = the workshop. Light = the paper record.
color._comment3: The four provenance classes. These are the product. Each has a -lift variant for dark grounds. `specified` is new — a bound cited from a manufacturer's published figure.
color._comment4: Status, for StatusPill. Held is the one that matters.
